starting_state: clean implementation worktree; fetched remote identical; unrelated main checkout preserved
unchanged: original Natural A93/A95/E94E95; model equilibrium K; finite inner nu and zero outer molecular diffusion; transported nonconstant inner k, dependent epsilon, full raw-gradient signed production and covariance; one-sweep ordering; no clipping, restoration, trace repair, reference residual cancellation, EP or backend expansion

sources.Richards_Norris: 2011 JWEIA99 pp257-266 DOI10.1016/j.jweia.2010.12.008, p259 Eq23/item4 and pp261-262 empty-domain test
sources.Cao_Tamura: 2006 section3.1 p6 Fig3e; u_tau/Uinf=.051 and d=.7*5mm determined before z0 fit

fit.selection_before_wall_feasibility: visible f3a_R points in 10--30.5mm physical height, starting above two nominal cube heights and ending near .12 of nominal .25m layer depth; corroborate with f3b_R near-wall shear before evaluating wall roots; not a claim to recover the authors unstated exact interval
fit.control: same points with d=0 reproduce archived CT4; no change to archived fits
fit.normalization: Hh=.04m and original U(40mm) interpolation; nu*=1/10500; no renormalization to fitted U(Hh)
fit.uncertainty: joint coordinate/velocity extraction on IDs0--5,4096 vertices+256 seeded Sobol interiors+central; same realization in fit and40mm normalization, including point3 and changed brackets; fixed membership; not confidence intervals; no invented experimental/probe or displacement uncertainty
fit.held_out: all unused f3a_R mean points, Fig3e duplicate and turbulence checks retain source roles; no hill fitting

wall.upper_height_constraint: strictly below nominal7mm rough Fig12 stress traverse, also report9.121mm lower flat-stress extraction; do not enlarge heights to obtain a root
wall.roughness_domain: 0<=h_s<H_A; original resistance and roughness correlation; h_s=H_A is a limiting diagnostic only
wall.proposed_policy: SamePhysicalWallDisplacedAcceptedCandidateV1: E=A/(max(r,c)-d), d<c<=H; flat budget P0/A=c/(c-d)+log((H-d)/(c-d)); require P0>=A*H/(H-d); reconstruct k, fluxes, stresses independently; no automatic native or curved admission
wall.alternatives: modeled wall at displacement plane changes domain and physical H; original d0 remains archived control, not experimental convention
wall.native_displaced_admission: requires a compatible separately versioned wall policy; never silently enable displacement on original Accepted profile

top.natural_data: t_x=+u_tau^2,g_k=0,g_epsilon=-u_tau^4/(sigma_epsilon*(Z_T-d)); prescribed physical fluxes, no evolving diffusivity factor
top.pressure: absolute outlet total traction, no mean gauge or separate top normal traction; physical pressure tests remain free
top.fixtures: small serial flat two-column P3/P1 and P4/P2; d0 compatible original Accepted reference is an explicitly nonexperimental control; all top modes and corner precedence checked
negative_controls: evolving-diffusivity substituted for physical epsilon datum

CT6.reuse: sealed RT12 governing executable and unchanged continuous MMS, Gaussian geometry and physical inventory; all old failures immutable
CT6.fresh: P4/P2 dt=.0005,T=.016,independent zero-step history; if temporal question resolves, one matched P3/P1 dt=.0005
CT6.comparison: new .002/.001/.0005 triplet with original .8--1.2 order band and1e-6 signal floor; absolute pressure admission; offset/spatial/interface pressure decomposition diagnostic only; degree threshold.85,uncertainty treatment unchanged
CT6.diagnosis: stored Pi time; initial weak continuity; actual stage/current-time lift vs frozen coefficients; flow/epsilon/k pressure and traction; refreshed dependent epsilon lag; no governing change without a violated discrete identity
CT6.model_transfer: only complete A95 admission permits bounded A93/E94E95 curved evolutions; no open-ended timestep/mesh search

target_domain.candidate: latest terrain generator audited first; absent superseding case use x=[-25,30]Hh,roof20Hh; flat pair retains extents, partitions, connectivity and reference functions
target_domain.geometry: positive injective normal collar joined to an outer map with fixed horizontal roof; pure normal experimental hill map cannot reach20Hh; new geometry definition is not native coupled-map qualification
target_domain.capacity: measure native count before evolution; retain3000 stored slots and all unsupported-route guards; over-limit domain remains unexecuted with explicit scalable assembly/solver work package
target_domain.preservation_if_admitted: requires complete reference and supported backend; predeclared1 flow-through,stages .01,.1,1 transit,independent dt pair chosen from target mesh scales; field drift1e-3 on u_tau,K,epsilon(H),u_tau^2; w1e-4; ground/interface traction1e-3; timestep spread<=max(1e-7,.1*measured drift),mass1e-8,complete budgets.02; no launch if admission blocked

stop: first genuine domain/accuracy/required gate failure retains candidate and last accepted history; continue independent scopes; do not launch inadmissible physical data or bypass capacity; collector completion is not admission
